Class MarkdownRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.format.markdown.MarkdownRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
FormatRenderer
public class MarkdownRenderer extends Object implements FormatRenderer
The MarkdownRenderer type walks a CommonMark tree and writes plain VT100 text. CommonMark is the markdown dialect this renderer parses. VT100 is the terminal control set the chat shell paints with. Emphasis markers are dropped, and the text inside them is kept. Headings, lists, quotes, and fenced code keep their structure. Prose is wrapped to the column width.

    • render

      public FormatResult render(String raw, FormatContext ctx)
      The render method parses the reply and writes each top-level block. If ctx is null, the wrap width is 80. Otherwise the wrap width is FormatContext.getColumns(). emitBlock(Node, StringBuilder, int) writes each top-level child in order. The result has body color on.
      Specified by:
      render in interface FormatRenderer
      Parameters:
      raw - The original assistant text.
      ctx - The render settings, or null to wrap at 80 columns.
      Returns:
      The plain VT100 text.

    • emitBlock

      private void emitBlock(org.commonmark.node.Node node, StringBuilder out, int width)
      The emitBlock method writes one top-level block. A heading or a paragraph is flattened by inlineText(Node), wrapped by WordWrap.wrap(String, int), and followed by two line feeds. A fenced code block copies its literal, adds a line feed when the literal does not already end with one, and then adds another line feed. A null code literal writes only the extra line feed. A bullet list or an ordered list writes each item as a hanging hyphen. The item body is trimmed and wrapped to width minus two. The first wrapped line starts with - , and later lines start with two spaces. A blank line follows the list. A block quote wraps to width minus two and prefixes every line with > , then adds a blank line. Any other block writes nothing.
      Parameters:
      node - The block to write.
      out - The destination.
      width - The column width.

      private String inlineText(org.commonmark.node.Node node)
      The inlineText method flattens one subtree to plain text. Emphasis markers are not copied. A link contributes its label, not its destination.
      Parameters:
      node - The subtree to flatten.
      Returns:
      The plain text collected by collectInline(Node, StringBuilder).

    • collectInline

      private void collectInline(org.commonmark.node.Node node, StringBuilder sb)
      The collectInline method appends the plain text of one subtree. If the node has no children, a text node or a code node appends its literal, and a soft or hard line break appends one space. Any other childless node appends nothing. A text child appends its literal. A code child appends its literal. A soft or hard line break appends one space. A link, emphasis, strong emphasis, paragraph, list item, or any other child is visited the same way. The link destination is not appended.
      Parameters:
      node - The subtree to walk.
      sb - The destination for the plain text.
